messages:
oliver_design: sketching a compact inline tool-swap pattern that emphasizes reversible actions. idea: 'Change' affordance on run row, immediate toast with "Undo" for 20s, and a collapsed provenance line that expands. mock: https://redwood.mock/s/compact-undo-swap.png sam_devex: nice. question: should the swap change be visible immediately in the run item, or only after confirming (apply)? my vote: reflect the selected tool immediately but mark it as "pending" until user reruns. keeps UI responsive. jamie_pm: product wants the action recorded immediately for audit but not applied to outputs until rerun. so UI: show "pending: toolB (changed by oliver_design)" in the run. audit event emitted on change. rory_a11y: accessibility checklist: - the toast must be accessible: role="status" + focusable undo button. - the inline provenance expander needs aria-expanded and an accessible name like "Show swap details for run 1833333000". - when the change happens, fire an aria-live announcement: "Tool changed to toolB. Press U to undo." kevin_engineer: implementation notes: we'll optimistically update UI state to pending and emit an event: {type: "tool_swap", run: 1833333000, from: "toolA", to: "toolB", actor: "oliver_design", pending: true}. Undo will flip pending=false and emit undo event. Caching: fetch tool metadata lazily. Example HTML we can use: ```html pending: toolB (changed by oliver_design)
Tool changed to toolB.
``` anya_research: in a small probe, users liked seeing the change reflected immediately but expected a clear indicator it wasn't applied. metrics: measure "swap_then_rerun_within_30s" and "swap_undone_within_20s". oliver_design: copy candidates for toast: - "Tool changed (pending) — Undo" - "Tool swap saved — Rerun to apply" - "Tool updated — not applied yet. Rerun to run with new tool." Which is the clearest? sam_devex: prefer "Tool swap saved — Rerun to apply" with an Undo action. short and explicit. also support keyboard shortcut 'U' mapped to Undo while toast visible. jamie_pm: ensure backend audit log records both the swap and whether it was applied. UI note: show small tag on run row like "pending" or "applied". avoid auto-apply. rory_a11y: microcopy tweak: include run time in aria-labels for context: aria-label="Change tool for run at 2026-03-22T11:05". toast should be reachable by screen reader and keyboard. deploy-bot: deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for playground/inline-undo-swap (build 9024)
